meta-description: MasscerAI is a platform that helps businesses create AI agents to automate customer conversations on WhatsApp and websites, manage relationships, and generate media—using your own data and tools.
hero-headline: Create AI agents that run your business conversations
hero-lede: MasscerAI is a software platform for businesses. Its purpose is to help you build custom AI agents that answer customers, automate WhatsApp and website chat, manage client relationships, and generate documents, images, and videos—using your knowledge base and integrations.
purpose-body: MasscerAI is an AI agent platform for companies and teams. You sign in at app.masscer.ai to create agents, connect channels (such as WhatsApp and website widgets), attach your data, and let agents handle inbound conversations and tasks. MasscerAI also supports Google Sign-In and optional Google Calendar / Drive connections so agents can act on your behalf when you enable those integrations.
purpose-who-body: Businesses, support teams, and operators who want AI agents that work with their real channels and data—not a generic chatbot demo.
purpose-how-body: Create an account, configure an agent with your knowledge and tools, connect WhatsApp or embed a chat widget, then monitor conversations and take over when needed from the MasscerAI dashboard.
features-title: What you can do with MasscerAI
feature-agents-desc: Build professional-grade AI agents with your data. Use them to answer messages, create videos and documents, and automate work.
feature-whatsapp-desc: Let your agent handle customer inquiries, support tickets, and conversations 24/7 on WhatsApp.
feature-embed-desc: Add a chat widget with your AI agent in minutes. Copy, paste, and start attending visitors live.
feature-relationships-desc: Stay on top of client and team conversations with AI insights—scale communication without losing the human touch.
mission-body: Our mission is to make professional AI agents practical for everyday business: easy to create, grounded in your data, and ready to serve customers on the channels you already use.
vision-body: We envision a world where every team can deploy trustworthy AI agents that handle routine communication and creative work, so people can focus on judgment, relationships, and growth.
about-page-intro: MasscerAI (also referred to as Masscer) is the product behind masscer.ai and app.masscer.ai. Below is our purpose, mission, and vision.
about-purpose-body: MasscerAI exists so organizations can create, configure, and operate AI agents that automate and assist business communication and workflows. Core capabilities include agent creation, WhatsApp automation, website chat embedding, relationship and conversation management, media generation, and integrations (including Google Sign-In and optional Google Calendar and Drive access when you connect them).
